details.s: Dori was a Dwarf of Durin's Folk, who, along with his brother Nori and cousin Ori, travelled with Bilbo Baggins and Thorin II as a member of Thorin's Company on the Quest for Erebor, to reclaim the Lonely Mountain from the dragon Smaug.

gallery.c: Dori as played by Mark Hadlow in Peter Jackson's The Hobbit trilogy
